@everyone CHARITY STREAM: SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 10AM–10PM

we’re raising $600 for Linden Community Pantry, and yes, i’m posting this early and pinning it this year. last year we raised $212, but half the server didn’t know until the day of because i posted way too late. not doing that again lol

donate at lindenpantry.example/mrkz — it goes straight to the pantry with nothing taken off. through their wholesale partner, every $1 means about 4 pounds of food, so even $3 helps. they’re serving around 340 families a week and the shelves are really low going into thanksgiving.

rook is matching the first $100 donated, so that first $100 counts double.

incentives:
🍖 $100 — i play a full round with the controller upside down
🍖 $250 — chat picks my hair dye color and i dye it ON STREAM
🍖 $400 — one hour of chat-picked songs only, no skipping
🍖 $600 — i vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry (they handle the donations and buy the food)

games: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join and i’ll drop the code. second half, chat votes on a new game every 2 hours. larry, no 12 hours of the same map, i promise.

no card or can’t donate? you can still help by showing up, sharing this post, joining games, and getting other people to stop by. locals can also drop canned/boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on saturdays, 9am–1pm. if you can’t give, genuinely no guilt—hanging out and spreading the word matters.

it’s a full day of games, terrible decisions, and hopefully a lot of food for linden. mark it down, bring your friends, and come hang out even if you’re just there to make the hair dye vote worse.
